items.title: Slide Hampton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: No, because he – see, Philly worked with Tadd.

ctx.x: Was that at all related to what Philly Joe Jones ultimately did [Dameronia]?

No, because he – see, Philly worked with Tadd. So he loved Tadd, and that’s the reason he played that music. I didn’t work with Tadd, but I got to know Tadd. He was a very – he was like his music sounds. That’s the kind of person he was. He was very beautiful.
Under what circumstances did you know him?
